documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Nine Months Ended On 30Th September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ELANTAS Beck India Limited reported strong business performance for the financial year 2025, with revenue from operations growing by 13.27% to ₹84,780.93 lakhs and margins improving compared to the previous year. The company experienced heightened demand in sectors such as continuous transposed conductor (CTC), electronics, e-mobility, and the power industry, while advancing key operational integrations including the Von Roll resin operations in India and SAP S/4HANA implementation. Furthermore, management is progressing with setting up a new manufacturing facility in Gujarat and maintaining a strong focus on industrial safety, sustainability, and technological localization. ELANTAS Beck India Limited reported a 10.09% increase in revenue from operations to 74,851.31 Lakhs for the financial year ended December 31, 2024, alongside a 10.74% increase in sales volume. The company acquired 30 acres of land in Bharuch, Gujarat, to establish a new manufacturing facility and purchased assets related to the resin and tapes product business from Von Roll (India) Private Limited.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the markets served by the company continue to show strong long-term potential in areas aligned with India's industrial growth and infrastructure expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the markets served by ELANTAS continue to show strong long-term potential.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted a surge in demand from the continuous transposed conductor (CTC) segment during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our manufacturing agility enabled us to respond swiftly to the surge in demand from the CTC (Continuous transposed conductor), scaling capabilities within three months to meet evolving customer requirements.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that materials support key growth sectors including electronics, e-mobility, and the power industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Our materials support sectors such as electronics, e-mobility, and the power industry, areas that are closely aligned with India’s industrial growth and infrastructure expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed new opportunities emerging in data centres, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and sustainable material technologies.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also seeing new opportunities emerging in areas such as data centres, BESS, and more sustainable material technologies.

demand_outlook.claim: The management noted that the overall industry indicated a slightly subdued demand in the second half of the year compared to the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: The overall industry indicated a slightly subdued demand in the second half of the year, compared the first half.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Your Company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and is currently in the process of obtaining the requisite governmental approvals.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended December 31, 2025 aggregated to ₹3,087.84 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended 31st December, 2025 aggregated to ₹ 3,087.84 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed the acquisition of assets relating to the resin and tapes product business from Von Roll (India) Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The acquisition of assets relating to the resin and tapes product business from Von Roll (India) Private Limited has enabled your Company to offer more tailored solutions and enhanced technology in the resin and tapes product segment, resulting in higher contribution from the Electrical Insulation Business.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating future-ready manufacturing expansion through greenfield development and greater automation.
capex_expansion.quote: At the same time, we are evaluating future-ready manufacturing expansion through greenfield development and greater automation in order to support the evolving needs of our customers.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that margins improved by nearly 19 percent compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 13.27 percent during the year, while margins improved by nearly 19 percent as compared to the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales quantity increased by 5.92% compared to the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of sales quantity, there was an increase of 5.92% as compared to the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share for the year ended December 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹ 7.50/- per equity share of ₹ 10/- each, subject to the deduction of tax as applicable, for the year ended 31st December, 2025 (previous year ₹ 7.50/- per equity share).

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the year unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, raw material price fluctuations, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year 2025 unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.

management_commitments.claim: ALTANA set a target to reduce emissions by 90 percent across Scope 1, 2 and 3 by 2050.
management_commitments.quote: ALTANA has set a target to reduce emissions by 90 percent across Scope 1, 2 and 3 by 2050, a target validated by the Science Based Targets initiative.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
